NASB.1: The sons of Judah [were] Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur and Shobal.

NASB.3: These [were] the sons of Etam: Jezreel, Ishma and Idbash; and the name of their sister [was] Hazzelelponi.
NASB.4: Penuel [was] the father of Gedor, and Ezer the father of Hushah. These [were] the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah, the father of Bethlehem.
NASB.5: Ashhur, the father of Tekoa, had two wives, Helah and Naarah.
NASB.6: Naarah bore him Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.
NASB.7: The sons of Helah [were] Zereth, Izhar and Ethnan.
NASB.8: Koz became the father of Anub and Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.
NASB.9: Jabez was more honorable than his brothers, and his mother named him Jabez saying, 'Because I bore [him] with pain.'
NASB.10: Now Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, 'Oh that You would bless me indeed and enlarge my border, and that Your hand might be with me, and that You would keep [me] from harm that [it] may not pain me!' And God granted him what he requested.
NASB.11: Chelub the brother of Shuhah became the father of Mehir, who was the father of Eshton.
NASB.12: Eshton became the father of Beth-rapha and Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Ir-nahash. These are the men of Recah.
NASB.13: Now the sons of Kenaz [were] Othniel and Seraiah. And the sons of Othniel [were] Hathath and Meonothai.
NASB.14: Meonothai became the father of Ophrah, and Seraiah became the father of Joab the father of Ge-harashim, for they were craftsmen.
NASB.15: The sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh [were] Iru, Elah and Naam; and the son of Elah [was] Kenaz.
NASB.16: The sons of Jehallelel [were] Ziph and Ziphah, Tiria and Asarel.
NASB.17: The sons of Ezrah [were] Jether, Mered, Epher and Jalon. (And these are the sons of Bithia the daughter of Pharaoh, whom Mered took) and she conceived [and bore] Miriam, Shammai and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.
NASB.18: His Jewish wife bore Jered the father of Gedor, and Heber the father of Soco, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah.
NASB.19: The sons of the wife of Hodiah, the sister of Naham, [were] the fathers of Keilah the Garmite and Eshtemoa the Maacathite.
NASB.20: The sons of Shimon [were] Amnon and Rinnah, Benhanan and Tilon. And the sons of Ishi [were] Zoheth and Ben-zoheth.
NASB.21: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah [were] Er the father of Lecah and Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of the linen workers at Beth-ashbea;

NASB.23: These were the potters and the inhabitants of Netaim and Gederah; they lived there with the king for his work.
NASB.24: The sons of Simeon [were] Nemuel and Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, Shaul;
NASB.25: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, Mishma his son.
NASB.26: The sons of Mishma [were] Hammuel his son, Zaccur his son, Shimei his son.
NASB.27: Now Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brothers did not have many sons, nor did all their family multiply like the sons of Judah.
NASB.28: They lived at Beersheba, Moladah and Hazar-shual,
NASB.31: Beth-marcaboth, Hazar-susim, Beth-biri and Shaaraim. These [were] their cities until the reign of David.
NASB.32: Their villages [were] Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen and Ashan, five cities;
NASB.33: and all their villages that [were] around the same cities as far as Baal. These [were] their settlements, and they have their genealogy.
NASB.34: Meshobab and Jamlech and Joshah the son of Amaziah,
NASB.35: and Joel and Jehu the son of Joshibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,
NASB.36: and Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah,
NASB.37: Ziza the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah;
NASB.38: these mentioned by name [were] leaders in their families; and their fathers' houses increased greatly.
NASB.39: They went to the entrance of Gedor, even to the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.
NASB.40: They found rich and good pasture, and the land was broad and quiet and peaceful; for those who lived there formerly [were] Hamites.
NASB.41: These, recorded by name, came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and attacked their tents and the Meunites who were found there, and destroyed them utterly to this day, and lived in their place, because there was pasture there for their flocks.
NASB.42: From them, from the sons of Simeon, five hundred men went to Mount Seir, with Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi, as their leaders.
NASB.43: They destroyed the remnant of the Amalekites who escaped, and have lived there to this day.

ESV.1: The sons of Judah: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.
ESV.2: Reaiah the son of Shobal fathered Jahath, and Jahath fathered Ahumai and Lahad. These were the clans of the Zorathites.

ESV.4: and Penuel fathered Gedor, and Ezer fathered Hushah. These were the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah, the father of Bethlehem.
ESV.5: Ashhur, the father of Tekoa, had two wives, Helah and Naarah;
ESV.6: Naarah bore him Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.
ESV.7: The sons of Helah: Zereth, Izhar, and Ethnan.
ESV.8: Koz fathered Anub, Zobebah, and the clans of Aharhel, the son of Harum.
ESV.9: Jabez was more honorable than his brothers; and his mother called his name Jabez, saying, “Because I bore him in pain.”
ESV.10: Jabez called upon the God of Israel, saying, “Oh that you would bless me and enlarge my border, and that your hand might be with me, and that you would keep me from harm  so that it might not bring me pain!” And God granted what he asked.
ESV.11: Chelub, the brother of Shuhah, fathered Mehir, who fathered Eshton.
ESV.12: Eshton fathered Beth-rapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah, the father of Ir-nahash. These are the men of Recah.
ESV.13: The sons of Kenaz: Othniel and Seraiah; and the sons of Othniel: Hathath and Meonothai.
ESV.14: Meonothai fathered Ophrah; and Seraiah fathered Joab, the father of Ge-harashim,  so-called because they were craftsmen.
ESV.15: The sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah, and Naam; and the son  of Elah: Kenaz.
ESV.16: The sons of Jehallelel: Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, and Asarel.
ESV.17: The sons of Ezrah: Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon. These are the sons of Bithiah, the daughter of Pharaoh, whom Mered married;  and she conceived and bore  Miriam, Shammai, and Ishbah, the father of Eshtemoa.
ESV.18: And his Judahite wife bore Jered the father of Gedor, Heber the father of Soco, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah.
ESV.19: The sons of the wife of Hodiah, the sister of Naham, were the fathers of Keilah the Garmite and Eshtemoa the Maacathite.
ESV.20: The sons of Shimon: Amnon, Rinnah, Ben-hanan, and Tilon. The sons of Ishi: Zoheth and Ben-zoheth.

ESV.22: and Jokim, and the men of Cozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who ruled in Moab and returned to Lehem  (now the records  are ancient).
ESV.23: These were the potters who were inhabitants of Netaim and Gederah. They lived there in the king's service.
ESV.24: The sons of Simeon: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, Shaul;
ESV.25: Shallum was his son, Mibsam his son, Mishma his son.
ESV.26: The sons of Mishma: Hammuel his son, Zaccur his son, Shimei his son.
ESV.27: Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brothers did not have many children, nor did all their clan multiply like the men of Judah.
ESV.28: They lived in Beersheba, Moladah, Hazar-shual,
ESV.31: Beth-marcaboth, Hazar-susim, Beth-biri, and Shaaraim. These were their cities until David reigned.
ESV.32: And their villages were Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan, five cities,
ESV.33: along with all their villages that were around these cities as far as Baal. These were their settlements, and they kept a genealogical record.
ESV.34: Meshobab, Jamlech, Joshah the son of Amaziah,
ESV.35: Joel, Jehu the son of Joshibiah, son of Seraiah, son of Asiel,
ESV.36: Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah,
ESV.37: Ziza the son of Shiphi, son of Allon, son of Jedaiah, son of Shimri, son of Shemaiah —
ESV.38: these mentioned by name were princes in their clans, and their fathers' houses increased greatly.
ESV.39: They journeyed to the entrance of Gedor, to the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks,
ESV.40: where they found rich, good pasture, and the land was very broad, quiet, and peaceful, for the former inhabitants there belonged to Ham.
ESV.41: These, registered by name, came in the days of Hezekiah, king of Judah, and destroyed their tents and the Meunites who were found there, and marked them for destruction to this day, and settled in their place, because there was pasture there for their flocks.
ESV.42: And some of them, five hundred men of the Simeonites, went to Mount Seir, having as their leaders Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.
ESV.43: And they defeated the remnant of the Amalekites who had escaped, and they have lived there to this day.

NLT.1: The descendants of Judah were Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.

NLT.6: Naarah gave birth to Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, and Haahashtari.
NLT.7: Helah gave birth to Zereth, Izhar, Ethnan,
NLT.8: and Koz, who became the ancestor of Anub, Zobebah, and all the families of Aharhel son of Harum.
NLT.9: There was a man named Jabez who was more honorable than any of his brothers. His mother named him Jabez because his birth had been so painful.
NLT.10: He was the one who prayed to the God of Israel, “Oh, that you would bless me and expand my territory! Please be with me in all that I do, and keep me from all trouble and pain!” And God granted him his request.
NLT.11: Kelub (the brother of Shuhah) was the father of Mehir. Mehir was the father of Eshton.
NLT.12: Eshton was the father of Beth-rapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah. Tehinnah was the father of Ir-nahash. These were the descendants of Recah.
NLT.13: The sons of Kenaz were Othniel and Seraiah. Othniel’s sons were Hathath and Meonothai.
NLT.14: Meonothai was the father of Ophrah. Seraiah was the father of Joab, the founder of the Valley of Craftsmen, so called because they were craftsmen.
NLT.15: The sons of Caleb son of Jephunneh were Iru, Elah, and Naam. The son of Elah was Kenaz.
NLT.16: The sons of Jehallelel were Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, and Asarel.
NLT.17: The sons of Ezrah were Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon. One of Mered’s wives became the mother of Miriam, Shammai, and Ishbah (the father of Eshtemoa).
NLT.18: He married a woman from Judah, who became the mother of Jered (the father of Gedor), Heber (the father of Soco), and Jekuthiel (the father of Zanoah). Mered also married Bithia, a daughter of Pharaoh, and she bore him children.
NLT.19: Hodiah’s wife was the sister of Naham. One of her sons was the father of Keilah the Garmite, and another was the father of Eshtemoa the Maacathite.
NLT.20: The sons of Shimon were Amnon, Rinnah, Ben-hanan, and Tilon. The descendants of Ishi were Zoheth and Ben-zoheth.
NLT.21: Shelah was one of Judah’s sons. The descendants of Shelah were Er (the father of Lecah); Laadah (the father of Mareshah); the families of linen workers at Beth-ashbea;
NLT.22: Jokim; the men of Cozeba; and Joash and Saraph, who ruled over Moab and Jashubi-lehem. These names all come from ancient records.
NLT.23: They were the pottery makers who lived in Netaim and Gederah. They lived there and worked for the king.
NLT.24: The sons of Simeon were Jemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zohar, and Shaul.
NLT.25: The descendants of Shaul were Shallum, Mibsam, and Mishma.
NLT.26: The descendants of Mishma were Hammuel, Zaccur, and Shimei.
NLT.27: Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters, but none of his brothers had large families. So Simeon’s tribe never grew as large as the tribe of Judah.
NLT.28: They lived in Beersheba, Moladah, Hazar-shual,
NLT.31: Beth-marcaboth, Hazar-susim, Beth-biri, and Shaaraim. These towns were under their control until the time of King David.
NLT.32: Their descendants also lived in Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Token, and Ashan — five towns
NLT.33: and their surrounding villages as far away as Baalath. This was their territory, and these names are listed in their genealogical records.
NLT.34: Other descendants of Simeon included Meshobab, Jamlech, Joshah son of Amaziah,
NLT.35: Joel, Jehu son of Joshibiah, son of Seraiah, son of Asiel,
NLT.36: Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah,
NLT.37: and Ziza son of Shiphi, son of Allon, son of Jedaiah, son of Shimri, son of Shemaiah.
NLT.38: These were the names of some of the leaders of Simeon’s wealthy clans. Their families grew,
NLT.39: and they traveled to the region of Gerar, in the east part of the valley, seeking pastureland for their flocks.
NLT.40: They found lush pastures there, and the land was spacious, quiet, and peaceful. Some of Ham’s descendants had been living in that region.
NLT.41: But during the reign of King Hezekiah of Judah, these leaders of Simeon invaded the region and completely destroyed the homes of the descendants of Ham and of the Meunites. No trace of them remains today. They killed everyone who lived there and took the land for themselves, because they wanted its good pastureland for their flocks.
NLT.42: Five hundred of these invaders from the tribe of Simeon went to Mount Seir, led by Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, and Uzziel — all sons of Ishi.
NLT.43: They destroyed the few Amalekites who had survived, and they have lived there ever since.
